name: Current Events
overview: Scripture reminds believers that God directs our paths and calls us to trust His guidance through all seasons of life, as seen when He commanded Abram to leave his homeland and promised to lead His people (Genesis 12:1; Deuteronomy 31:8). In times of uncertainty and heaviness, the Word encourages maintaining wisdom and discretion to navigate challenges wisely (Proverbs 3:21) and to offer encouragement that uplifts the heart (Proverbs 12:25). Recognizing that every event unfolds in God's appointed time (Ecclesiastes 3:1), believers are called to discern and reject deceitful speech that seeks to harm (Psalms 52:2), anchoring their hope in the steadfast presence of the Lord.
